contract.callback_exception_isolation: An exception raised by one callback does not abort EventBus.emit()
contract.delivery_continuation: Callback delivery continues after a callback raises an exception
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful when a registered callback raises an exception
contract.registry_stability: Callback exceptions do not corrupt or mutate the listener registry
contract.repeatability: Subsequent emits remain successful after a callback exception
contract.callback_activation: All registered callbacks remain active after an isolated callback exception
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus event delivery requires the events permission
